column6: Phase 2 bunionectomy trial (NCT07574385) recruiting since 2026-03-10, funded by $6M Series A closed 2025-06-12.

Newest dated public artifact is a 2023 academic case study of PastureBox deployments; no 2025/2026 dated news, filing, or careers signal found; renaissanceag.com unreachable 2026-08-13; LinkedIn/Facebook pages active but posts undated.
NIH SBIR Phase II award ($1.5M) "Clinical Validation of Myoelectric Implant for Intuitive Prosthesis Control" started 2025-03-01; company careers page listings themselves are stale (2021).
Deseret News reports MOU with Fulcrum Point Holdings for a 10 MW closed-loop geothermal pilot near Brigham City, construction targeted Q1 2027; follows $38M oversubscribed Series A closed Dec 2025.
Dated changelog posts product updates through 2026-07-25 (scheduling, crew, user settings) on Rotor's own feedback hub.
PR Newswire 2026-01-06: Lehi-based SalesRabbit announced acquisition of Roofle; careers board at salesrabbit.breezy.hr still lists openings.
Sandbox Fellowship page (published 2026-07-10) lists May 2026 start dates, tuition, Provo location, and live apply links for the current cycle.

Sarcos renamed Palladyne AI (NASDAQ: PDYN) in 2024; Q2 2026 results dated 2026-08-06 show $5.8M revenue and reiterated FY2026 guidance; hardware/XO line discontinued in the software pivot. Work continues under the new name (ruling 3).
GlobeNewswire 2026-04-23 (via Manila Times): SchoolAI released Jordan School District two-year study results and ESSA Tier 3 rating; company blog also describes Back to School 2026 product release.
SCI Institute news page dated 2026-07-23 reports faculty Rohan Basu Roy among first DOE Genesis Mission awardees; institute continues posting research news through July 2026.
EIN Presswire 2026-08-03: Sethera announced a strategic research collaboration with Receptor.AI for polymacrocyclic peptide discovery; follows Aug 2025 PNAS platform paper.
PR Newswire 2026-07-15: Park City-based Skullcandy launched Crusher 1080 ANC headphones with Sound by Bose, on sale globally.
SkyWest Inc. Form 10-K for year ended 2025-12-31, signed and filed 2026-02-17; operating regional airline from St. George HQ.
Sky Quarry Inc. (NASDAQ: SKYQ) Form 10-K for year ended 2025-12-31 filed 2026-03-31 from Woods Cross HQ; still a reporting public company.
DoD contract digest 2026-03-21: MDA awarded USU/SDL a $414M modification (P00020) raising HQ0854-22-D-0001 ceiling to $714M, work in Logan through 2031.

Medical Product Outsourcing 2025-09-15: Spectrum Health Science (successor to Spectrum Solutions saliva-device maker) appointed Damon Silvestry CEO of SimplyTest; saliva collection devices still listed at spectrumsolution.com. Work continues under the new brand (ruling 3).
Focused Ultrasound Foundation 2026-04-30: first participants enrolled in SPIRE DIADEM pivotal trial NCT07226648 (ClinicalTrials.gov recruiting; start 2025-12-11; Utah site recruiting).

Splunk Platform blog 2026-08-04: Machine Data Lake, Catalog, and Agent Launchpad generally available under Cisco; work continues post-acquisition (ruling 3). Cisco FY2026 Q4 earnings 2026-08-12 also report Splunk new logos.
Strider newsroom 2026-04-25 reprints Bloomberg profile of the South Jordan firm still selling strategic-intelligence software, including Utah DPS land-ownership work and a new agentic AI launch.
Struvia author page lists dated product blog posts through 2026-07-21; site live with takeoff/bid-management product. No independent filing or named-customer corroboration found.
